assessmentTargets.concept: Identify the three main components of a fully connected autoencoder and their functions
assessmentTargets.supportingEvidence: The encoder takes the image and converts the flattens of image, performs encoding and then gives it to one... latent space that is the compressed form and latent space output is given as input to decoder and decoder will try to reconstruct the image
assessmentTargets.evidenceSpan: The encoder takes the image ... decoder will try to reconstruct the image

assessmentTargets.concept: Compare fully connected and convolutional autoencoders in terms of dimensionality handling and reconstruction quality
assessmentTargets.supportingEvidence: The first main reason why fully auto encoder fail is because the 2d dimension of image is directly converted into one... Hence, with this particular drawback, we are going for convolutional order encoder where the 2d image is not directly converted into one

assessmentTargets.instruction: Ask the student to explain why convolution preserves spatial structure better than flattening.

assessmentTargets.concept: Explain why variational autoencoders were introduced and how they improve reconstruction accuracy over earlier autoencoders
assessmentTargets.supportingEvidence: ...variational auto encoders... reconnects the original image up till 70 or 60 percent as the original image, unlike fully connected where the accuracy is only around 60 or 50
assessmentTargets.evidenceSpan: ...variational auto encoders... reconnects the original image up till 70 or 60 percent... accuracy is only around 60 or 50
assessmentTargets.instruction: Have the learner describe the accuracy gap and the role of VAE in closing it.

assessmentTargets.concept: Define Gaussian mean and variance in the VAE latent space and state their significance for image reconstruction
assessmentTargets.supportingEvidence: When you talk about the KL divergence concept in the variational auto encoders, we understand about the mean of the data distribution and also the variance of the data distribution... we are not checking one point, I am checking mean and variance of the data
assessmentTargets.evidenceSpan: ...understand about the mean of the data distribution and also the variance... we are not checking one point, I am checking mean and variance of the data
assessmentTargets.instruction: Ask the student to write the meaning of mean and variance in this context.

assessmentTargets.concept: Explain how KL divergence regularizes the VAE latent distribution to match a normal Gaussian
assessmentTargets.supportingEvidence: And the KL divergence makes sure that the mean and the variance of the data are close to what? Close to the normal distribution
assessmentTargets.evidenceSpan: ...KL divergence makes sure that the mean and the variance of the data are close to ... the normal distribution
assessmentTargets.instruction: Require the learner to describe the effect of KL divergence on mean and variance alignment.

reserveTargets.concept: Identify at least two practical scenarios where autoencoders are used for image compression
reserveTargets.supportingEvidence: Now, there are applications where I want to extract the images as original images
reserveTargets.evidenceSpan: Now, there are applications where I want to extract the images as original images

reserveTargets.concept: Explain why autoencoders help reduce computational complexity in training large image datasets
reserveTargets.supportingEvidence: We try to compress the image... the size of the image would be reduced and we are able to understand the features also
reserveTargets.evidenceSpan: ...compress the image... size of the image would be reduced and we are able to understand the features also
reserveTargets.instruction: Ask the student to relate compression to training speed.

reserveTargets.concept: Differentiate deterministic point encoding from probabilistic distribution encoding in latent spaces
